primitives.name: authority_generation
primitives.protocol: reserve → materialize capsules/ledger rows → verify closure → publish root → retire
primitives.invariant: No reader observes a root whose children are incomplete

primitives.name: archive_object_graph
primitives.protocol: reserve manifest → stage objects/repair symbols → verify identities/closure → publish root → audit retrieval
primitives.invariant: Remote object existence alone is not publication

primitives.name: search_generation
primitives.protocol: build provisional delta → seal immutable segments → continuity check → publish generation → retire
primitives.invariant: Provisional searchable state is explicitly marked non-durable

primitives.name: graph_projection
primitives.protocol: consume capsule frontier → build/advance tiers → compare reference digest → publish projection root
primitives.invariant: Projection declares consumed authority high-water mark

primitives.name: model_activation
primitives.protocol: stage artifacts → verify hash/license/profile → shadow qualify → publish activation → retain rollback
primitives.invariant: Downloaded or merely loadable model is not active

primitives.name: calibration_activation
primitives.protocol: solve candidate → held-out validate → privacy reproject → publish certificate → monitor invalidators
primitives.invariant: Low residual without held-out/coverage checks is insufficient

primitives.name: adapter_compatibility_profile
primitives.protocol: probe exact tuple → run fixture/live gates → publish profile → revoke on drift
primitives.invariant: Device-family success never generalizes across firmware/app tuples

primitives.name: evidence_bundle
primitives.protocol: freeze anchor/ranges → materialize siblings → verify redaction/closure → publish bundle root
primitives.invariant: Human report and machine manifest publish atomically

primitives.name: deletion_closure
primitives.protocol: plan reachable set → seal basis root → revalidate → tombstone/delete → rebuild projections → publish proof
primitives.invariant: Deletion success requires alternate-index/cache reachability closure

primitives.name: release_root
primitives.protocol: clean snapshot → qualify target matrix → assemble exact assets/SBOM/source → sign → publish draft/root → download verify
primitives.invariant: Partial target success cannot bless an aggregate release
